% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpSlideNote[legend=Speaker notes,lang=en-GB,show-text]{
  \wcScript[type=tp/txt]|Introduce the idea. [trigger=clic] Explain the next step.|
}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/slide-note/slide-note.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-slide-note");
element1.setAttribute("legend", "Speaker notes");
element1.setAttribute("lang", "en-GB");
element1.setAttribute("show-text", "");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element2 = document.createElement("script");
element2.setAttribute("type", "tp/txt");
element2.textContent = "Introduce the idea. [trigger=clic] Explain the next step.";
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example External notes
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpSlideNote[legend=External notes,src=/docs/components/slide-note/examples/notes.txt,lang=en-GB,show-text]{}
\end{document}
